body.name: executable SA-CS-ID transition system
body.construction: Encode the initial tuple \(\zeta_0\) by \(\operatorname{enc}_H\). Repeatedly apply the first eligible relation among \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\) under \(\mathfrak P_H\). A transition is admitted only after its finite syntactic eligibility test and exact polynomial local obligation succeed; the successor must have smaller \(\mu_H\). The residual relation is the only halting relation and emits either the verified rational circuit with its denominator domain or the verified global-twin box.
